10   invocation will be offered by the Reverend Peter 

11   G. Young, of the Mother Teresa Community here in  

12   Albany.  

13                Father?

14                REVEREND YOUNG:   Thank you, 

15   Senator.  

16                Let us pray.  

17                In today's budget discussions, 

18   citizens will be asking you to share God's love 

19   to one another and to strive toward a way of 

20   life in keeping with Your plan, O Heavenly 

21   Father.  

22                Send down Your blessings on these 

23   Senators who have devoted themselves to helping 

24   all of our New York State citizens.  Our 

25   invocation today calls to us to heed the word 


                                                                1517

 1   and the call of Your heart here, and of our 

 2   passion for equity.  

 3                O God, You are the creator of all 

 4   things.  You have placed on these Senators the 

 5   obligation of toil to better the lives of all 

 6   New York State citizens, and we call on You, 

 7   God, to bless them with energy and good health 

 8   for their most challenging senatorial duties.  

 9                Amen.  

10                ACTING PRESIDENT GRIFFO:   Thank 

11   you, Father.
